question: In which of the following years was the Saansad Adarsh Gram Yojana (SAGY) launched with the aim to translate the comprehensive vision of Mahatma Gandhi about an ideal Indian village into reality, keeping in view the present context?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2014**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Saansad Adarsh Gram Yojana (SAGY)** was launched on **11 October 2014** by the Government of India.
 
• The scheme was introduced by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** and aims to develop model villages across India through the adoption and development by Members of Parliament (MPs).
 
• The vision of SAGY is inspired by **Mahatma Gandhi's ideals of an ideal Indian village**, integrating modern technology with traditional practices.
 
• Under SAGY, MPs are encouraged to adopt villages and develop them into model villages by focusing on areas such as **health, education, sanitation, livelihood, and infrastructure**.
 
• The program specifically aims at **holistic development** and ensuring basic amenities, quality education, and sustainable livelihoods in the selected villages.
